verdict.rationale: Ollama is a local and cloud LLM inference runtime, so paged KV-cache memory management is a fair performance axis for it. The evidence pack never documents paged attention or KV-cache paging. The related mentions are only adjacent: cloud 'dedicated capacity' throughput, running multiple models concurrently, and a community remark about better memory handling on Apple Silicon via MLX. None of these establish paged KV-cache management or fragmentation-free concurrency.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on paged memory management for attention key/value cache to maximize concurrent request capacity without memory fragmentation
